verdict.rationale: Square documents a Terminal API (terminal-api/overview) that runs checkouts on Square hardware, with configurable options such as tip screens and custom tip amounts. Webhooks, a sandbox, and a server-side TypeScript SDK support a backend-driven integration. However, the pack only shows the Terminal API indirectly, through a single checkout-option snippet, and never explicitly describes how a backend creates and pushes a checkout to the device. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the backend-to-device checkout request and status flow (e.g., creating terminal checkouts and pairing devices), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a custom POS built on the Terminal API.
